candidate_horizontal_crs: EPSG:32638 candidate UTM zone 38N; survey authority to confirm or replace

acceptance_evidence: approved projected CRS, epoch, units, geoid model and vertical datum
least-squares residuals, covariance/uncertainty and rejected-observation record
signed monument descriptions and protection/inspection plan
datasets.delivery_format: RINEX plus field logs, adjustment report, coordinate schedule and signed control report
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Primary control <=10 mm horizontal and <=15 mm vertical expanded uncertainty; interface control <=5 mm relative to accepted project control. Survey authority must approve or replace these project targets.
datasets.scope: Stable primary/secondary monuments covering every corridor, station, depot, bridge, energy site and construction compound.
datasets.title: Primary and secondary survey control

acceptance_evidence: signed completeness review against route limits
datasets.delivery_format: GeoPackage 3D points/lines/polygons plus LandXML terrain and accepted PDF plans
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Hard-surface/detail points <=25 mm horizontal and <=20 mm vertical; general ground <=50 mm. Survey authority must approve class-by-feature targets and check density.
datasets.scope: Full corridor, station, depot, access, watercourse, road, structure, compound and lifting-route coverage with breaklines and feature coding.
datasets.title: Corridor and site topographic survey

acceptance_evidence: verification exposure/trial-hole schedule where design risk warrants
datasets.delivery_format: GeoPackage 3D utility features, investigation records, photographs and confidence/quality attributes
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Every feature carries horizontal/vertical uncertainty and detection/verification method; trial holes or records alone must not be silently treated as surveyed truth.
datasets.scope: Electricity, telecoms, water, sewer, drainage, fuel, irrigation and unknown services within the works influence zone.
datasets.title: Above- and below-ground utilities

datasets.delivery_format: GeoPackage boundaries/rights plus controlled title, consent and access register
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Boundary geometry remains indicative until reconciled to authoritative records and verified by the competent land authority.
datasets.scope: Ownership, occupation, easements, road reserve, temporary access, compounds, lifting routes and acquisition constraints.
datasets.title: Property, right-of-way and access constraints

acceptance_evidence: authority-approved design storm and discharge constraints
datasets.delivery_format: GeoPackage water/flood/outfall layers plus rainfall, level, model and authority records
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Levels use the accepted vertical datum; rainfall return periods and climate allowances require local authority confirmation.
datasets.scope: Catchments, channels, historical levels, culverts, outfalls, tailwater, groundwater indicators and exceedance routes affecting the works.
datasets.title: Hydrology, flood and drainage evidence

acceptance_evidence: desk study, walkover and conceptual ground model
factual logs and chain of custody
strength, settlement, corrosivity and groundwater parameters with uncertainty
signed geotechnical design recommendations and residual risks
datasets.delivery_format: AGS or equivalent structured logs, coordinates, samples/tests, factual report and interpretive design report
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Investigation spacing/depth and tests are risk-based and approved by the geotechnical engineer after desk study and walkover.
datasets.scope: Boreholes, CPTu, test pits, groundwater monitoring and laboratory programme zoned for at-grade, elevated, station, depot and energy works.
datasets.title: Ground investigation and laboratory testing

datasets.delivery_format: asset/capability register, measured layouts, utilities, photographs and gap assessment
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Critical lifting, clearance and interface dimensions are measured to the tolerance required by the selected equipment supplier.
datasets.scope: Buildings, pits, cranes, lifting, machine tools, power, compressed air, fire systems, stores, access and workforce capability.
datasets.title: Existing workshop and depot capability audit

datasets.delivery_format: fleet register, measured interface sheets, duty/condition records and migration constraints
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Safety and physical interfaces use independently checked measurements and controlled vehicle/configuration identity.
datasets.scope: Existing vehicles, gauges, couplers, wheel/rail, depot interfaces, rescue, operating rules and reusable components relevant to the pilot.
datasets.title: Existing fleet and operating interface audit

acceptance_evidence: capture plan, permissions and privacy controls
check-point residuals, voids, artefacts and obscuration map
datasets.delivery_format: source-image manifest and hashes, camera logs, GCP/check points, orthophoto/DSM and processing report
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Ground sampling distance and independent check-point limits are agreed by use case; neither EXIF position nor self-reported processing precision is acceptance evidence.
datasets.scope: Continuous corridor and detailed station/depot/structure/utility-context coverage, subject to permissions and privacy controls.
datasets.title: Georeferenced photography and photogrammetry

acceptance_evidence: independent check points and cloud-to-cloud sections
density, range, noise, void and movement/change register
datasets.delivery_format: E57/LAS/LAZ plus station setup, targets/control, registration and CloudCompare QA report
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Registration RMS is reported but not used alone; independent control/check residuals and local interface comparisons govern acceptance.
datasets.scope: Complex structures, station/depot interfaces, constrained utilities and clearance-critical areas selected by the design team.
datasets.title: Point-cloud and dimensional interface capture

acceptance_evidence: owner, producer, checker and accepting authority per dataset
licence, reuse, publication and personal-data constraints
file naming, metadata, revision and immutable hash rules
datasets.delivery_format: responsibility matrix, naming/revision rules, common-data-environment plan, licence/consent register and acceptance record
datasets.provisional_accuracy: Not applicable; this package governs provenance, access, revision, retention and authorized use.
datasets.scope: All raw and derived field information, personal/sensitive content, third-party records and authoritative project derivatives.
datasets.title: Information ownership, security and acceptance

external_gate: The appointed survey authority, architect/engineer of record, operator and information manager approve this brief, responsibility matrix, CRS, vertical datum, accuracy schedule, access plan and data rights before field capture.
raw_data_policy: Keep raw survey, imagery, scan, utility and personal data in access-controlled project storage; Git contains requirements, manifests, hashes, accepted summaries and non-sensitive derivatives only.
